items.title: CoreWeave債務疑慮升至歷史高點 市場有人低聲提起「雷曼」
items.title_en: CoreWeave Debt Concerns Hit Historic Highs, Market Whispers “Lehman”
paras: 《Benzinga》報導，2007 年第三季，為雷曼兄弟 (Lehman Brothers) 的 1,000 萬美元債務投保一年，保費不到 10 萬美元。一年後，同樣的保障成本已超過 140 萬美元，而這家銀行也已申請破產。如今，為 CoreWeave (CRWV-US) 債務購買同樣的保險，一年約需支付 115 萬美元。因此，華爾街擱置了近 20 年的比較，如今再度浮上檯面。
根據標普全球市場情報 (S&P Global Market Intelligence) 提供數據，CoreWeave 的五年期信用違約交換 (CDS) 利差在週一(26日)上午達到 1,148 個基點。
標普全球提供的過去 12 個月數據顯示，該利差在 10 月 22 日攀升至 1,167 個基點，創下這段資料期間的最高紀錄。一個月前，利差為 835 個基點；一年前則為 421 個基點。
標普全球對 CoreWeave 採用 40% 的回收率假設。在這項假設下，目前的定價意味著，該公司未來五年內的違約機率約為 62%。
此外，CoreWeave 與其他 AI 相關企業之間的差距也相當大。如今，CoreWeave 為債務投保所支付的成本，約為微軟 (MSFT-US) 的 21 倍。此外，其成本也是北美投資級信用違約交換指數 (CDX North American Investment Grade Index) 的 18 倍，該指數週一報 63 個基點。
市場有人低聲提起「雷曼」
金融策略師、Windshift Capital 執行長Bill Blain在 10 月 16 日發布的電子報中提出了這項比較。
Blain表示，「CoreWeave 在爭奪成為 AI 債務泡沫第一起重大崩盤事件的競賽中，已經遙遙領先。所有重大的金融泡沫，都需要一個關鍵時刻，讓人們『清醒過來，認清金錢的真相』（或是根本沒有錢）。也就是市場意識到，自己已經不在堪薩斯州的那一刻。」
他接著指出，「2007 年，北岩銀行 (Northern Rock) 遭遇擠兌，短期融資開始枯竭；之後，貝爾斯登 (Bear Stearns) 的 CDO 基金也陷入困境……從那時起，危機開始自行加速發展，雷曼這樣的銀行即將倒閉，也逐漸成為難以避免的局面。」
獨立市場評論員James Foord在 10 月 22 日發布的 Substack 文章中，進一步提出類比。他稱 CoreWeave 是這一輪週期中的雷曼，並表示：「考量到其債券目前反映的風險，這樣的比較是合理的。」
Foord接著將 Nebius Group N.V. 比作這一輪週期中的摩根大通，認為它擁有較強的資產負債表，能夠在市場淘汰潮中存活，並接手其他公司的資產。
摩根大通財富管理部門在 10 月 23 日的一份報告中，也提出了類似的比較，儘管報告並未點名相關公司。
全球投資策略師Justin Biemann描述了一家高度依賴融資的 AI 基礎設施借款企業，其五年期 CDS 在當週攀升至 1,100 個基點。
Biemann指出，這樣的定價意味著，該公司未來五年的違約機率接近或超過 50%，高於一年前不到 30% 的水準。「這並不是預測，但也很難將其視為無關緊要。」不過，他強調，目前的壓力是針對特定企業的。投資人為信用狀況最弱的 AI 借款企業購買債務保障，所需支付的成本約為信用狀況最強企業的 10 倍；整體投資級債券的信用保障成本則仍維持在相對受控的水準。
Biemann表示，市場的擔憂主要集中在這類商業模式：企業必須仰賴債務市場持續開放融資，同時又維持高額支出與有限的現金流。
馬斯克進一步加劇市場壓力
與此同時，馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 週一的發言也讓市場壓力升高。他在社群平台 X 上發文表示，貸款機構幾乎已停止向那些在 AI 資料中心以外缺乏大量營收的公司提供融資。他也預測，200 多家新雲端業者 (neoclouds) 將面臨「小魚等級的死亡潮與產業整併」。
CoreWeave 股價在週一交易時段初期跌至 51.24 美元，創下 2025 年 5 月以來最低水準，之後買盤進場。收盤股價上漲 1.76%，報 55.19 美元。
即便如此，該股仍較過去 52 週的高點 141.79 美元下跌 60%。CoreWeave 目前市值約為 310 億美元，相較之下，其包含租賃負債在內的總債務約為 516 億美元。
不過，摩根大通提醒，不應將 CDS 利差解讀為違約倒數計時。
2005 年，一家美國大型汽車製造商的債務投保成本在其信用評等遭降至垃圾級之前大幅攀升。然而，該公司成功籌集現金、進行重整，最終並未申請破產。
雷曼兄弟則走上了相反的道路。2008 年 9 月中旬，隨著該銀行走向倒閉，其五年期 CDS 利差已升至 1,400 個基點以上。
CoreWeave 目前的利差比這個水準低約 250 個基點。因此，安全緩衝空間已經變得有限，但市場反映的是風險，而不是已經確定的結果。
CoreWeave 最終會走上哪一條路，將取決於貸款機構是否願意繼續為其基礎設施擴建提供資金，直到公司的現金流足以跟上債務規模。
paras_en: Benzinga reported that in the third quarter of 2007, insuring Lehman Brothers’ $10 million debt for one year cost less than $100,000 in premiums. A year later, the same protection cost over $1.4 million, and the bank had filed for bankruptcy. Today, insuring CoreWeave’s (CRWV‑US) debt with comparable coverage costs about $1.15 million per year, reviving a comparison that has been dormant on Wall Street for nearly two decades.
According to data from S&P Global Market Intelligence, CoreWeave’s five‑year credit default swap (CDS) spread reached 1,148 basis points on Monday morning, the 26th.
S&P Global’s twelve‑month data show the spread peaked at 1,167 basis points on October 22, the highest level in the sample period. A month earlier it was 835 bps, and a year ago it was 421 bps.
S&P Global assumes a 40% recovery rate for CoreWeave. Under that assumption, the current pricing implies roughly a 62% probability of default over the next five years.

The gap between CoreWeave and other AI‑related firms is also stark. The cost CoreWeave pays to insure its debt is about 21 times that of Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and roughly 18 times the level of the CDX North American Investment Grade Index, which was quoted at 63 bps on Monday.
The market is quietly invoking “Lehman.”
Financial strategist and Windshift Capital CEO Bill Blain raised the comparison in an October 16 newsletter.

Blain wrote, “CoreWeave is already far ahead in the race to become the first major collapse of the AI‑debt bubble. Every major financial bubble needs a moment when people ‘wake up and see the truth about money’ (or realize there is no money). That moment is when the market realizes it is no longer in Kansas.”

He continued, “In 2007 Northern Rock faced a run and short‑term funding dried up; then Bear Stearns’ CDO funds got into trouble… From there the crisis accelerated on its own, and a bank like Lehman was bound to fail.”

Independent market commentator James Foord expanded the analogy in a Substack post on October 22, calling CoreWeave the Lehman of this cycle and saying, “Given the risk reflected in its bonds, the comparison is reasonable.”
Foord then likened Nebius Group N.V. to the JPMorgan of this cycle, arguing it has a stronger balance sheet that can survive the market purge and absorb other companies’ assets.
JPMorgan’s wealth‑management division made a similar comparison in a report dated October 23, although it did not name any specific firms.
Global investment strategist Justin Biemann described a highly leveraged AI infrastructure borrower whose five‑year CDS jumped to about 1,100 bps that week.

Biemann noted that such pricing implies a default probability of roughly 50% or higher over the next five years, up from under 30% a year earlier. “This is not a forecast, but it’s hard to treat it as irrelevant,” he said, adding that the pressure is currently focused on a specific company. Investors are paying roughly ten times more for credit protection on the weakest AI borrower than on the strongest, while overall investment‑grade bond protection costs remain relatively contained.
Biemann said market worries center on business models that must rely on continuously open debt markets for financing while maintaining high spend and limited cash flow.
Musk Further Fuels Market Pressure

At the same time, Elon Musk’s comments on Monday added to market stress. On X he wrote that lenders have virtually stopped financing companies that lack substantial revenue outside AI data centers. He also warned that more than 200 “neocloud” entrants will face a “small‑fish‑level death spiral and industry consolidation.”
CoreWeave’s stock fell to $51.24 early in Monday’s trading session, its lowest level since May 2025, before buyers stepped in. The share closed up 1.76% at $55.19.
Even so, the stock remains about 60% below its 52‑week high of $141.79. CoreWeave’s market value is roughly $31 billion, while its total debt—including lease liabilities—is about $51.6 billion.
JPMorgan cautioned that CDS spreads should not be read as a countdown to default.

In 2005 a major U.S. automaker saw its debt‑insurance costs surge dramatically before its credit rating slipped into junk territory. The company later raised cash, restructured and avoided bankruptcy.
Lehman Brothers took the opposite path. By mid‑September 2008, as the bank headed toward collapse, its five‑year CDS spread had risen above 1,400 bps.
CoreWeave’s current spread is about 250 bps lower than that level, leaving a limited safety buffer. The market is pricing risk, not a foregone conclusion.
Which path CoreWeave ultimately takes will depend on whether lenders continue to fund its infrastructure expansion until cash flow can keep pace with its debt load.

items.title: 美股選後行情有望續漲？標普500歷史平均漲15.5%、2027年進入總統任期最佳周期
items.title_en: Will Post‑Election US Stocks Keep Rising? S&P 500’s Historical Average Gains 15.5% – 2027 Enters the Best Cycle of a Presidential Term
paras: 標普500指數距離歷史高點可能僅差幾個百分點，但半導體及其他熱門人工智慧（AI）概念股大幅回檔，已讓許多投資人感到不安。好消息是，歷史數據顯示，美股後市未必悲觀。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，長期以來的歷史規律顯示，無論今年11月美國期中選舉由哪個政黨勝出，股市都可能持續走高。
金融顧問內容平台 Exhibit A 創辦人 Matt Cerminaro 的分析指出，自1950年以來，標普500指數從期中選舉投票日到隔年6月30日，平均上漲15.5%。
然而，考慮到市場仍面臨多項可能持續帶來考驗的風險，未來走勢或許不如預期樂觀。儘管本週債市上漲，帶動10年期公債殖利率回落至5%以下，但美國公債殖利率仍接近數十年來的高點。
此外，伊朗戰爭仍在持續，原油價格也回升至投資人自5月以來未曾見過的水準。
此外，Meta(META-US) 最新財報似乎未能消除市場對AI投資報酬的疑慮。隨著Anthropic預計近期上市，部分投資人也擔心，若再出現一宗大型IPO，龐大的新股供給可能超出市場承接能力，進一步壓抑股票需求。
不過，市場也存在正面因素。
CFRA Research首席投資策略師 Sam Stovall 表示：「過去，高油價曾成為熊市的催化因素，利率上升也曾造成同樣的結果。市場面臨的逆風確實很多，但我認為，企業獲利已抵銷了這些逆風帶來的部分疑慮。」
值得注意的是，美國大型企業近期的獲利成長速度相當驚人，華爾街也預期，企業在2027年仍將持續交出亮眼成績。雖然過去的報酬率無法保證未來表現，但從歷史紀錄來看，市場前景仍相當穩健。
Cerminaro表示，期中選舉期間最好的投資策略，就是關掉電視，並在投票日設定買進委託單。
Stovall指出，明年將進入美國總統四年任期周期的第三年，而從歷史來看，這通常是股市表現最強的時期。
在構成總統四年任期周期的16個季度中，期中選舉年的第四季平均表現排名第二；緊接而來的第三年第一季，則是平均表現最佳的季度。
Stovall認為，這種現象並非單純的統計巧合，而與執政黨維持政治優勢的動機有關。他表示，執政黨希望在下一次總統大選後繼續掌權，因此往往會提前採取較為溫和的刺激措施，相關政策效果可能在總統或執政黨尋求連任時逐步顯現。
美國總統川普已經提前展開相關措施。在共和黨國會議員的支持下，川普於2025年推動了具有里程碑意義的減稅措施。
在期中選舉造勢期間，川普也表示，如果共和黨成功保住美國參議院與眾議院的控制權，他將向每位美國成年民眾發放5,000美元的「紅利」。
Stovall的統計也顯示，即使不在選舉年，股市通常也會在第四季交出強勁表現。根據Stovall的統計，第四季是四個曆年季度中平均報酬率最高的季度。
近期股市的主要跌勢集中在科技股。由於科技股在標普500指數中的權重略低於40%，若要讓標普500指數達到與歷史表現相當的報酬率，科技股很可能也必須參與漲勢。
盈透證券首席策略師 Steve Sosnick 表示：「我還沒有完成精確的數學計算，但如果沒有大型科技公司的參與，標普500指數要出現可觀漲幅，可能性極低。」
paras_en: The S&P 500 is only a few percentage points away from its historic peak, but a sharp pullback in semiconductor and other hot AI‑related stocks has left many investors uneasy. The good news is that historical data suggests the US equity market’s outlook may not be bleak.
According to MarketWatch, long‑standing historical patterns show that regardless of which party wins the November midterm elections this year, the stock market could continue to climb.

Analysis by Matt Cerminaro, founder of the financial‑advice platform Exhibit A, notes that since 1950 the S&P 500 has risen an average of 15.5% from the midterm election day to June 30 of the following year.

However, given that the market still faces several risks that could linger, the future trajectory may be less optimistic than hoped. Although the bond market rose this week, pulling the 10‑year Treasury yield back below 5%, US Treasury yields remain near multi‑decade highs.
In addition, the war involving Iran continues, and oil prices have rebounded to levels investors haven’t seen since May.

Meta (META‑US)’s latest earnings also appear to have failed to allay market concerns about AI investment returns. With Anthropic expected to go public soon, some investors worry that another large IPO could flood the market with new shares, overwhelming demand and further suppressing stock buying.
Nevertheless, there are positive factors in the market.

CFRA Research chief investment strategist Sam Stovall said, “In the past, high oil prices have acted as a bear‑market catalyst, and rising rates have produced the same effect. The market does face many headwinds, but I think corporate earnings have offset some of the concerns these headwinds generate.”

It is noteworthy that large US companies have recently posted astonishing profit‑growth rates, and Wall Street expects firms to continue delivering strong results through 2027. While past returns can’t guarantee future performance, historical records suggest the market outlook remains fairly robust.
Cerminaro advises that the best midterm‑election strategy is to turn off the TV and set a buy order for election day.
Stovall points out that next year will be the third year of a US presidential four‑year cycle, which historically is the strongest period for stock performance.

Within the 16 quarters that make up a presidential four‑year cycle, the fourth quarter of a midterm‑election year ranks second on average, while the first quarter of the third year is the top‑performing quarter overall.

Stovall believes this pattern isn’t just a statistical coincidence but is linked to the incumbent party’s motivation to maintain political advantage. He says the ruling party, hoping to stay in power after the next presidential election, often implements relatively moderate stimulus measures early, with policy effects materialising as the president or party seeks re‑election.
US President Trump has already begun rolling out such measures. Backed by Republican members of Congress, Trump pushed a landmark tax‑cut package in 2025.
During the midterm‑election campaign, Trump also said that if Republicans retain control of the Senate and the House, he will give every adult American a $5,000 “bonus.”

Stovall’s statistics also show that even in non‑election years, the stock market typically delivers strong fourth‑quarter performance. According to his data, the fourth quarter has the highest average return of the four calendar quarters.

The recent market decline has been concentrated in technology stocks. Because tech stocks make up just under 40% of the S&P 500, achieving a historically comparable return for the index likely requires tech participation in the rally.

Interactive Brokers chief strategist Steve Sosnick said, “I haven’t completed the precise math yet, but without participation from large tech companies, the odds of the S&P 500 posting a sizable gain are extremely low.”

items.title: 「債券投資人已代勞！」 穆迪首席經濟學家連兩月示警：Fed升息將是一個「錯誤」
items.title_en: Bond Investors Have Already Done the Work! Moody's Chief Economist Warns for Two Consecutive Months That a Fed Rate Hike Would Be a "Mistake"
paras: 面對Fed今年剩下兩次會議及市場對再次升息的預期，穆迪首席經濟學家Mark Zandi週一(26日)在X平台上發文明確反對進一步緊縮貨幣政策，直言「此舉將是錯誤的」。
文中指出，債市已在替Fed完成緊縮任務，當前10年期美債殖利率在5%附近劇烈波動，固定抵押貸款利率穩守7%以上高位，公司債利差亦持續擴大，借貸成本的大幅上升正實質性抑制經濟活動。
Zandi說，「如果利率不能盡快回落，將造成實質性損害」，並強調債券投資人實際上已在執行Fed本該做的工作。
針對本周即將召開的FOMC會議，他特別示警地緣政治風險對通膨的擾動。「受到與伊朗緊張局勢影響，全球油價正急劇回升並逼近戰時高點，這無疑將加劇通膨壓力，但升息並不能解決石油供應問題。相反地，油價上漲會進一步削弱居民實質工資，打擊消費支出，最終拖累經濟」。
Zandi還說，在Fed9月做出升息決定時，他便已警告這是一個「嚴重的錯誤」。如今，在宏觀與地緣不確定性高企之際，Fed正試圖在「戰爭引發的通膨」與「對脆弱經濟日益成長的威脅」之間尋求平衡，此時若選擇升息恐將令經濟陷入停滯的風險。
paras_en: Facing the Fed’s two remaining meetings this year and market expectations of another rate hike, Moody’s chief economist Mark Zandi posted on X on Monday (the 26th) to explicitly oppose further monetary tightening, stating “this would be a mistake.”

He noted that the bond market is already doing the Fed’s tightening job: the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield is swinging wildly around the 5% level, fixed‑rate mortgage rates are holding above 7%, corporate bond spreads continue to widen, and the sharp rise in borrowing costs is materially dampening economic activity.
Zandi said, “If rates do not come down quickly, it will cause real damage,” and stressed that bond investors are actually carrying out the work the Fed should be doing.

Regarding the upcoming FOMC meeting this week, he warned specifically about geopolitical risks disrupting inflation. “Because of tensions with Iran, global oil prices are soaring sharply toward wartime highs, which will undoubtedly intensify inflation pressure, but raising rates cannot solve the oil‑supply problem. On the contrary, higher oil prices will further erode real wages, hit consumer spending, and ultimately drag down the economy.”

Zandi also said that when the Fed makes its September rate‑hike decision, he will have warned that it is a “serious mistake.” Now, amid high macro and geopolitical uncertainty, the Fed is trying to balance “war‑driven inflation” against “the growing threat to a fragile economy,” and choosing to hike rates at this point could risk pushing the economy into stagnation.

items.title: 美股重點新聞摘要2026年10月27日
items.title_en: US Stock Key News Summary October 27, 2026
paras:
特斯拉大漲5%甩開其他「七巨頭」躍居10月漲幅之冠

2026 年大部分時間裡，特斯拉(Tesla)(TSLA-US)一直是「科技七巨頭」（Magnificent Seven）中表現最不起眼成員。但到了 10 月，它卻成了唯一一路加速、把其他成員遠遠甩在後頭的股票。特斯拉股價週一(26日)大漲逾 5%，創下 9 月初以來最大單日漲幅，收盤價也來到近三個月新高。全文詳讀

Meta擬發行350億美元股票 輝達、超微、博通有意掏錢

Meta Platforms (META-US)計劃在未來幾個月透過不同形式的股票發行，籌集近 1,000 億美元。該公司週一(26日)表示，這項計畫將分階段進行。該公司首先計劃發行總額 350 億美元的普通股與特別股，以支應公司在人工智慧領域的投資。Meta 在新聞稿中表示，輝達 (NVDA-US)、超微(AMD-US) 與博通 (AVGO-US) 已表達參與意願，三家公司合計有意透過這次發行認購 50 億美元的股票。全文詳讀

博通與多家銀行合作進行630億美元AI融資 購置AI設備租予Anthropic

博通 (AVGO-US) 攜手美國銀行、黑石、花旗及摩根士丹利，安排規模達630億美元的融資計畫，透過新設立的特殊目的公司 (SPV)，購買博通的人工智慧 (AI) 運算設備，再出租給 Claude 開發商 Anthropic，相關設備預計自2027年開始交付。全文詳讀

總額上看1205億美元 SpaceX可望從Anthropic算力支出中大賺一筆

隨著 Anthropic 未來幾年持續成長，SpaceX (SPCX-US)可望成為其中一大受益者。Anthropic 於週一(26日)提交的首次公開募股（IPO）公開說明書中，揭露了未來幾年可能支付給 SpaceX 的金額。Anthropic 已與 SpaceXAI 簽訂多項協議，將使用搭載輝達 (NVDA-US) GPU 的運算資源，以滿足其運算需求。全文詳讀

蘋果iPhone Duo上市首週傳螢幕破裂 公司證實少數裝置受影響、提供換機

多家媒體報導，蘋果 (AAPL-US) 首款摺疊手機 iPhone Duo 上市首個週末，部分用戶便通報內螢幕破裂，或出現從鉸鏈處延伸的水平亮線。蘋果週一 (26 日) 證實，已知悉少數裝置的內螢幕出現問題，呼籲受影響用戶聯絡 AppleCare 安排換機，但尚未公布故障原因，也未說明是否需要調整設計或製程。全文詳讀
paras_en: Tesla surged more than 5% on Monday, outpacing the other “Magnificent Seven” stocks to claim the top spot for October gains. Throughout most of 2026, Tesla (TSLA-US) had been the least notable member of the tech giants, but in October it became the only stock accelerating ahead, leaving its peers far behind. The share jumped over 5% on Monday the 26th, marking its biggest single‑day rise since early September and closing near a three‑month high.

Meta plans to raise nearly $100 billion through various stock offerings over the coming months. The company said on Monday the 26th that the program will be rolled out in phases, starting with a $35 billion issuance of common and preferred shares to fund its artificial‑intelligence investments. In its press release, Meta noted that Nvidia (NVDA-US), AMD (AMD-US) and Broadcom (AVGO-US) have expressed interest, collectively intending to subscribe for $5 billion of the new shares.

Broadcom (AVGO-US) teamed up with Bank of America, Blackstone, Citi and Morgan Stanley to arrange a $63 billion AI financing program. Through a newly created special‑purpose vehicle, the funds will be used to purchase Broadcom’s AI compute equipment, which will then be leased to Claude developer Anthropic, with deliveries slated to begin in 2027.

Looking at a total of $120.5 billion, SpaceX (SPCX-US) could stand to earn a substantial sum from Anthropic’s compute spending. As Anthropic’s IPO prospectus filed on Monday the 26th shows, the company may pay significant amounts to SpaceX over the next few years. Anthropic has signed multiple agreements with SpaceX AI to use compute resources powered by Nvidia (NVDA-US) GPUs to meet its processing needs.

Apple’s first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, saw reports of screen breakage during its debut weekend. Apple (AAPL-US) confirmed on Monday the 26th that a small number of devices have internal screen issues, advising affected users to contact AppleCare for replacements. The company has not disclosed the cause of the defect nor indicated whether design or manufacturing changes are required.

items.title: 史上最大IPO要來了！Anthropic 7位創辦人身家均逾130億美元
items.title_en: The Largest IPO in History Is Coming! All Seven Anthropic Founders Worth Over $13 Billion Each
paras: 美國人工智慧（AI）公司Anthropic正式遞交上市文件，部分投資人預期估值可達2兆美元，若實現，將超越SpaceX(SPCX-US) 上市時的估值，成為史上規模最大的IPO。招股書並揭露，公司7位創辦人身家均超過130億美元，全數躋身全球富豪榜前300名。
Anthropic於美國當地時間10月26日宣布，已向美國證券交易委員會（SEC）提交A類普通股首次公開發行（IPO）的S-1註冊聲明，計劃在那斯達克掛牌，股票代號為「ANT」，發行股數與價格區間尚未確定。
公司已於6月秘密提交上市申請。文件顯示，此次IPO由高盛與摩根士丹利牽頭，另有20家銀行參與承銷。Anthropic及部分股東將在IPO中出售股票，具體股數將於後續文件揭露。
估值挑戰2兆美元 創辦人身家有望再攀升
Anthropic此次上市備受資本市場關注，部分投資人給予的估值預期達2兆美元。若能達成，將超越SpaceX今年6月上市時約1.77兆美元的估值，登上史上最大IPO寶座。
招股書顯示，包括Dario Amodei與Daniela Amodei兄妹在內的7位創辦人，各持有約1.4%股份。以最近一輪融資的9,650億美元估值計算，每人身家均超過130億美元，全部名列全球富豪榜前300名。
若IPO估值達到2兆美元，在尚未計入新股發行造成的股權稀釋前，7位創辦人的身家將各自超過270億美元。
營收快速成長 上半年虧損含大額非現金費用
招股書草案顯示，Anthropic今年上半年營收約163億美元，接近去年同期的15倍；第三季營收季增45%至168億美元，但成長速度較第二季放緩。
公司上半年淨虧損807億美元，高於去年同期的130億美元。其中，720億美元來自可轉換債券等金融工具估值變動產生的會計費用，並非實際現金支出。
隨著業務擴張，上半年算力與基礎建設支出接近90億美元，去年同期則為23億美元。公司已承諾，未來十年在雲端服務、算力等方面至少支出5,180億美元，總成本可能攀升至7,500億美元。
Anthropic表示，隨著算力與基礎設施持續擴張，資本支出預計將大幅增加，未來一段時間營運與投資活動的淨現金流出將維持高檔，即使財務表現改善，現金流出仍可能持續增加。
上市時程受關注 可能延至期中選舉後
根據央視財經先前報導，路透引述多名知情人士指出，Anthropic正考慮推出全新AI模型，同時可能將IPO延後至美國11月期中選舉之後。先前亦有報導指出，公司最早要到10月中旬才會啟動路演。
paras_en: U.S. artificial intelligence company Anthropic officially filed its listing documents, with some investors projecting a valuation of up to $2 trillion. If achieved, it would surpass SpaceX (SPCX-US) at its IPO and become the biggest IPO ever. The prospectus also reveals that all seven founders have net worths exceeding $13 billion, placing each of them among the world’s 300 richest people.

Anthropic announced on October 26 (U.S. time) that it has submitted an S‑1 registration statement to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a Class A common‑stock IPO, planning to list on Nasdaq under the ticker “ANT.” The number of shares and price range have not yet been set.

The company secretly filed its listing application in June. The filing shows the IPO is being led by Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley, with a total of 20 banks participating in the underwriting. Anthropic and certain shareholders will sell shares in the IPO, with the exact amount to be disclosed in later documents.
Valuation Challenge of $2 Trillion – Founders’ Wealth Likely to Rise Further

The IPO has attracted intense attention from capital markets, with some investors estimating a $2 trillion valuation. If realized, it would exceed SpaceX’s roughly $1.77 trillion valuation at its June‑year‑ago listing, making it the largest IPO in history.

The prospectus shows that the seven founders, including siblings Dario Amodei and Daniela Amodei, each hold about 1.4% of the company. Based on the most recent financing round’s $965 billion valuation, each founder’s net worth exceeds $13 billion, putting all of them on the global billionaire list’s top 300.
If the IPO valuation reaches $2 trillion, before accounting for dilution from new shares, each founder’s stake would be worth more than $27 billion.
Rapid Revenue Growth – H1 Loss Includes Large Non‑Cash Charges

The draft prospectus indicates Anthropic’s revenue for the first half of this year was about $16.3 billion, nearly 15 times that of the same period last year; third‑quarter revenue rose 45% year‑over‑year to $16.8 billion, though growth slowed compared with the second quarter.

The company posted a H1 net loss of $80.7 billion, up from $13 billion a year earlier. Of that, $72 billion stemmed from accounting charges related to valuation changes in convertible bonds and other financial instruments, not actual cash outflows.

With business expansion, H1 spending on compute and infrastructure approached $9 billion, versus $2.3 billion a year earlier. Anthropic has pledged to spend at least $518 billion over the next ten years on cloud services, compute and related costs, potentially pushing total costs to $750 billion.

Anthropic said that as compute and infrastructure continue to expand, capital expenditures will rise sharply, and net cash outflows from operating and investing activities will remain high for some time. Even if financial performance improves, cash outflows may keep increasing.
IPO Timing Under Scrutiny – May Be Delayed Past Midterm Elections

According to a prior report by CCTV Finance, Reuters cited several insiders saying Anthropic is considering launching a brand‑new AI model and may push the IPO to after the U.S. November midterm elections. Earlier reports also indicated the roadshow would not start until mid‑October at the earliest.

items.title: 英特爾量子布局再下一城 宣布收購以色列Classiq
items.title_en: Intel Expands Quantum Footprint with Acquisition of Israel's Classiq
paras: 英特爾(INTC-US) 宣布，已就收購以色列量子軟體新創Classiq達成最終協議，將整合量子硬體與軟體能力，擴大量子運算布局。
執行長陳立武表示，此次合併將把英特爾量子運算部門轉型為「全端量子運算業務」。交易預計2027年上半年完成，仍待監管機關核准，收購金額未揭露。
整合軟硬體 補足量子運算布局
Classiq於2020年成立，總部位於以色列特拉維夫，迄今已完成逾2億美元融資，現有約130名員工，客戶包括寶馬集團與AT&T等大型企業。
此次收購將結合Classiq的量子演算法自動合成平台，以及英特爾在矽基自旋量子位元製造、低溫控制電子裝置領域的能力，讓英特爾能同時提供量子硬體與軟體解決方案。
英特爾投入量子運算已逾十年，以自旋量子位元技術為核心。該公司表示，目前只有英特爾能利用傳統矽基半導體製程與設備，大規模生產量子位元晶片及複雜的低溫控制電子元件。相較於硬體布局，其量子軟體仍有缺口，Classiq將補上這一環。
降低開發門檻 平台延伸至量子處理器
Classiq的核心產品是不受底層量子位元類型與硬體限制的統一軟體平台，結合人工智慧工具、高階量子建模語言及設計自動化能力，讓開發者、研究人員與企業不必深入掌握底層量子電路設計，也能建立可擴充的量子應用程式。
英特爾將這項技術比擬為40年前電子設計自動化（EDA）與電腦輔助設計（CAD）軟體帶來的變革。這些工具透過簡化複雜硬體的設計操作，推動積體電路設計從少數專業人士掌握的領域，走向規模化產業。
收購完成後，英特爾的運算平台產品組合將從中央處理器（CPU）、繪圖處理器（GPU）及特殊應用積體電路（ASIC），進一步延伸至量子處理單元（QPU）。
財報前宣布收購 搶占新興市場
這項交易在英特爾第三季財報發布前夕宣布。在陳立武帶領下，英特爾已初步穩定先前承壓的財務狀況，並尋求在AI運算領域奪回遭競爭對手侵蝕的市占率，量子運算則是另一個潛在機會。
Classiq共同創辦人Nir Minerbi表示，這場革命是從科學轉向工程的過程，「當你想到工程，就會想到英特爾」。
維持開放平台 商業化仍有挑戰
量子運算利用亞原子粒子的量子特性加速資料處理，原理上可處理傳統電腦難以解決的複雜問題。不過，儘管多家企業正探索其商業潛力，大規模部署仍面臨高度複雜的硬體挑戰。
英特爾強調，量子運算將與傳統運算協同工作，而非全面取代現有架構。交易完成後，Classiq平台也將持續支援多家量子硬體供應商，包括英特爾競爭對手的產品，維持開放生態系定位。
英特爾提醒，交易仍有延遲完成、未獲監管核准及預期整合效益無法實現等風險，量子運算的商業化時程與市場規模也存在高度不確定性。
paras_en: Intel (INTC-US) announced that it has reached a final agreement to acquire Israeli quantum‑software startup Classiq, aiming to integrate quantum hardware and software capabilities and broaden its quantum computing portfolio.

CEO Chen Li‑wu said the deal will transform Intel’s quantum computing division into a “full‑stack quantum computing business.” The transaction is expected to close in the first half of 2027, pending regulatory approval, and the purchase price was not disclosed.
Integration of software and hardware to fill gaps in Intel’s quantum strategy

Classiq was founded in 2020 and is headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel. To date it has raised over $200 million and employs about 130 people, with customers that include BMW Group and AT&T among other large enterprises.

The acquisition will combine Classiq’s quantum algorithm auto‑synthesis platform with Intel’s expertise in silicon‑based spin‑qubit manufacturing and low‑temperature control electronics, enabling Intel to offer both quantum hardware and software solutions.

Intel has been investing in quantum computing for more than a decade, centering on spin‑qubit technology. The company says it is currently the only one that can leverage conventional silicon semiconductor processes and equipment to mass‑produce qubit chips and complex cryogenic control electronics. While its hardware footprint is strong, its quantum software lagged, and Classiq will fill that gap.
Lowering development barriers and extending the platform to quantum processors

Classiq’s core product is a unified software platform that is agnostic to the underlying qubit type or hardware. It combines AI tools, a high‑level quantum modeling language, and design automation capabilities, allowing developers, researchers and enterprises to build scalable quantum applications without deep expertise in low‑level circuit design.

Intel likens the technology to the transformation brought about 40 years ago by electronic design automation (EDA) and computer‑aided design (CAD) software. Those tools simplified complex hardware design, moving integrated‑circuit development from a niche of specialists to a mass‑scale industry.

After the acquisition, Intel’s compute‑platform portfolio will expand beyond central processing units (CPU), graphics processing units (GPU) and application‑specific integrated circuits (ASIC) to include quantum processing units (QPU).
Acquisition announced ahead of earnings to capture emerging market

The deal was disclosed just before Intel’s third‑quarter earnings release. Under Chen’s leadership, Intel has begun to stabilize its previously strained finances and is seeking to regain market share lost to rivals in AI computing, while viewing quantum computing as another growth opportunity.
Classiq co‑founder Nir Minerbi said the revolution represents a shift from science to engineering, “When you think engineering, you think Intel.”
Maintaining an open platform amid commercialization challenges

Quantum computing leverages the quantum properties of sub‑atomic particles to accelerate data processing and, in principle, can tackle problems that are intractable for classical computers. However, despite many firms exploring its commercial potential, large‑scale deployment still faces significant hardware complexity.

Intel stresses that quantum computing will complement, not replace, traditional computing architectures. After the deal closes, the Classiq platform will continue to support multiple quantum hardware vendors, including products from Intel’s competitors, preserving an open‑ecosystem stance.

Intel cautioned that the transaction remains subject to delays, regulatory approval and the risk that anticipated integration benefits may not materialize. The commercialization timeline and market size for quantum computing also remain highly uncertain.

items.title: 劍指中國！歐盟11/1起對境外小包裹收手續費
items.title_en: Targeting China! EU to Charge Handling Fees on Overseas Small Parcels Starting Nov 1
paras: 歐盟自11月1日起將對境外價值低於150歐元的小包裹收取2歐元手續費，《法新社》指出，此舉明顯劍指中國。
這項新徵收的費用——在「黑色星期五」、「網購星期一」和聖誕節購物季來臨之際幾周前實施，將疊加在歐盟7月對小包裹徵收的3歐元關稅之上。
這項手續費按商品稅目實施，即無論包裹價值如何，包裹中每一種直接寄往歐盟消費者的物品均適用此費用。
舉例說，若包裹裡有10件T恤衫，手續費為2歐元；若包裹裡有2頂帽子和10件T恤衫，手續費為4歐元。
歐盟稱，歐洲消費者無需支付手續費，但在線零售商和賣家有可能在銷售前額外收取2歐元費用。
對此，歐洲消費者組織（BEUC）表示，他們「擔心某些平台可能會試圖在購買最後階段將這些新費用轉嫁給消費者」。
根據歐盟官方數據，去年有近60億件小型包裹進入歐盟，其中約93%來自中國，通常通過AliExpress、Temu等平台。自歐盟今年7月對小包裹徵收3歐元關稅以來，進口量驟降約64%。
2歐元手續費是永久徵收的費用，但歐盟對小包裹徵收的3歐元關稅是臨時措施，期限至2028年7月1日。
paras_en: The EU will begin charging a €2 handling fee on overseas parcels valued under €150 starting November 1, AFP noted, a move that clearly targets China.
The new fee, implemented weeks before the “Black Friday,” “Cyber Monday,” and Christmas shopping season, will be added on top of the €3 tariff on small parcels that the EU introduced in July.
The handling fee is applied per product category, meaning that regardless of the parcel’s total value, each distinct item sent directly to an EU consumer incurs the fee.
For example, a parcel containing ten T‑shirts would incur a €2 fee; a parcel with two hats and ten T‑shirts would incur a €4 fee.
The EU says European consumers will not have to pay the fee, but online retailers and sellers may charge the €2 extra before sale.
In response, the European Consumer Organisation (BEUC) warned that they are “concerned some platforms might try to pass these new costs onto consumers at the final purchase stage.”

According to EU official data, nearly 6 billion small parcels entered the bloc last year, about 93% of which came from China, typically via platforms such as AliExpress and Temu. Since the EU imposed the €3 tariff on small parcels in July, import volumes have plunged roughly 64%.
The €2 handling fee is a permanent charge, whereas the €3 tariff on small parcels is a temporary measure set to expire on July 1, 2028.

items.title: Amkor先進封裝拉升毛利率至18.3%，第四季運算業務營收估年增逾五成
items.title_en: Amkor's Advanced Packaging Boosts Gross Margin to 18.3%, Q4 Computing Business Revenue Expected to Grow Over 50% YoY
paras: 2026年10月27日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 封測大廠安靠Amkor(AMKR-US)10月26日公布第三季財報，營收19.91億美元（約新台幣647億元），與去年同期相近，毛利率卻由14.3%升至18.3%，並較第二季提高1.5個百分點。公司表示，運算及車用業務成長，使高附加價值先進封裝占比提高，是獲利能力改善的主要原因；當季淨利1.91億美元（約新台幣62億元）。
運算業務第三季營收季增25%、年增37%，占總營收比重由去年同期19%提高至26%。主要動能來自高密度扇出型封裝（HDFO）CPU專案擴大量產，以及其他資料中心專案成長。這類先進封裝用來整合高效能晶片，安靠同時提供封裝與測試，客戶合作也由後段製造延伸至產品架構、技術路線與產能規畫。公司預期第四季另有兩項網通及資料中心2.5D封裝專案投入生產。
安靠預估，第四季運算業務營收將季增低雙位數、年增逾50%，但整體營收估為19億至20億美元（約新台幣618億至650億元），依財測中值估算，較第三季小幅下滑。原因是通訊與消費電子仍受零組件短缺影響；第三季通訊營收已季減8%，公司預期第四季再減高個位數，消費電子營收也將季減約15%。在產品組合持續改善下，第四季毛利率仍估為18%至19%。
為承接先進封裝需求，安靠正擴充韓國、越南與美國亞利桑那州據點。公司將部分系統級封裝（SiP）生產移往越南，騰出的韓國無塵室空間則投入先進封裝。管理層表示，客戶開始更早討論產品設計與產能，並以長期承諾及預付款支持擴產；自2025年以來，公司已與12家客戶簽訂預付款安排，主要用於韓國與亞利桑那州的先進封裝產能。
公司預估2026年資本支出約25億美元（約新台幣813億元），第一期亞利桑那州廠房工程仍預計2027年底完成。管理層預期2027年資本支出將再增加，主要投入亞利桑那州、韓國與越南廠房，確切財測留待明年2月公布。

paras_en: On October 26, 2026, leading test‑and‑pack provider Amkor Technology (AMKR‑US) released its third‑quarter results, reporting revenue of $1.991 billion (approximately NT$64.7 billion), roughly flat year‑over‑year, while gross margin rose from 14.3% to 18.3% and improved by 1.5 percentage points versus the second quarter. The company said growth in its computing and automotive segments increased the share of high‑value advanced packaging, which was the main driver of the margin improvement; net income for the quarter was $191 million (about NT$6.2 billion).

Computing‑related revenue grew 25% sequentially and 37% year‑over‑year in the third quarter, raising its contribution to total revenue from 19% a year ago to 26%. The boost came primarily from large‑scale production of high‑density fan‑out (HDFO) CPU projects and other data‑center projects. These advanced packages integrate high‑performance chips, and Amkor offers both packaging and testing, extending customer collaboration beyond back‑end manufacturing to product architecture, technology roadmaps, and capacity planning. The company expects two additional 2.5D networking and data‑center packaging projects to enter production in the fourth quarter.

Amkor forecasts that fourth‑quarter computing revenue will increase by a low double‑digit percentage sequentially and more than 50% year‑over‑year, but overall revenue is projected at $1.9 billion to $2.0 billion (about NT$61.8 billion to NT$65.0 billion), a slight decline from the third quarter based on the median of its financial outlook. The dip is attributed to ongoing component shortages affecting communications and consumer electronics; communications revenue fell 8% sequentially in Q3 and is expected to decline by a high single‑digit percentage in Q4, while consumer‑electronics revenue is projected to drop about 15% sequentially. With the product mix continuing to improve, fourth‑quarter gross margin is still estimated at 18%‑19%.

To meet rising demand for advanced packaging, Amkor is expanding facilities in South Korea, Vietnam, and Arizona, USA. The company is shifting part of its system‑in‑package (SiP) production to Vietnam, freeing clean‑room space in Korea for advanced packaging. Management said customers are beginning design and capacity discussions earlier and are supporting expansion with long‑term commitments and pre‑payments; since 2025, Amkor has signed pre‑payment agreements with 12 customers, primarily to fund advanced‑packaging capacity in Korea and Arizona.

Amkor estimates 2026 capital expenditures at roughly $2.5 billion (about NT$81.3 billion), with the first phase of the Arizona plant still slated for completion by the end of 2027. Management expects capital spending to rise again in 2027, focusing on the Arizona, Korean, and Vietnamese sites, with detailed financial guidance to be released in February next year.

items.title: Vertiv推出AI機櫃整合方案SmartIT，電力與液冷出廠前完成驗證
items.title_en: Vertiv Launches AI Cabinet Integration Solution SmartIT, Power and Liquid Cooling Verified Before Shipping
paras: 2026年10月27日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 資料中心電力與散熱設備商Vertiv(VRT-US)10月26日推出SmartIT高密度AI基礎設施方案，將機櫃、直流供電、晶片液冷與監控整合成套，並在出廠前完成系統驗證。公司表示，SmartIT已開放全球供貨，主要面向企業、研究機構與資料中心代管業者。
隨著AI運算密度提高，供電、散熱與伺服器之間需要更緊密配合。SmartIT以輝達MGX及開放運算計畫OCP架構為基礎，讓客戶透過單一供應商採購整合設備，減少現場協調不同廠商的工作。依公司說明，客戶可由單一機櫃擴充至多櫃，沿用既有架構，降低重新整合的工作量。
Vertiv表示，SmartIT先前已與輝達合作部署、支援DGX GB300；Rubin系列的部分配置則尚待推出，最終規格與商業供應仍須完成工程驗證。設備內建漏液偵測、警報與監控，並可搭配安裝、試運轉及後續維護服務。
採用整合機櫃的客戶，仍須事先備妥機房電力與冷卻條件。依產品文件，上游配電、供水及建築結構工程不包含在機櫃套件內；不同冷卻配置，則須搭配足夠的設施冷水容量或室內空調散熱能力。

paras_en: October 27, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) – Data center power and cooling equipment vendor Vertiv (VRT-US) announced on October 26 its SmartIT high‑density AI infrastructure solution, which integrates cabinets, DC power, chip‑level liquid cooling and monitoring into a single package and completes system verification before leaving the factory. The company says SmartIT is now available for global supply, targeting enterprises, research institutions and data‑center colocation providers.

As AI compute density rises, tighter coordination among power, cooling and servers is required. SmartIT is built on NVIDIA MGX and the Open Compute Project (OCP) architecture, allowing customers to procure integrated equipment from a single supplier and reduce on‑site coordination of multiple vendors. According to the company, customers can scale from a single cabinet to multiple cabinets while reusing the existing architecture, lowering the effort needed for re‑integration.

Vertiv notes that SmartIT has previously been deployed with NVIDIA to support DGX GB300; some configurations of the Rubin series are still pending launch, and final specifications and commercial supply will still require engineering validation. The equipment includes built‑in leak detection, alarms and monitoring, and can be paired with installation, commissioning and ongoing maintenance services.

Customers using the integrated cabinet must still prepare the data‑center’s power and cooling conditions in advance. According to product documentation, upstream power distribution, water supply and building‑structure work are not included in the cabinet kit; different cooling configurations require sufficient chilled‑water capacity or indoor HVAC cooling capability.

items.title: CoreWeave債務疑慮升至歷史高點 市場有人低聲提起「雷曼」
items.title_en: CoreWeave Debt Concerns Hit Historic Highs, Market Whispers “Lehman”
paras: 《Benzinga》報導，2007 年第三季，為雷曼兄弟 (Lehman Brothers) 的 1,000 萬美元債務投保一年，保費不到 10 萬美元。一年後，同樣的保障成本已超過 140 萬美元，而這家銀行也已申請破產。如今，為 CoreWeave (CRWV-US) 債務購買同樣的保險，一年約需支付 115 萬美元。因此，華爾街擱置了近 20 年的比較，如今再度浮上檯面。
根據標普全球市場情報 (S&P Global Market Intelligence) 提供數據，CoreWeave 的五年期信用違約交換 (CDS) 利差在週一(26日)上午達到 1,148 個基點。
標普全球提供的過去 12 個月數據顯示，該利差在 10 月 22 日攀升至 1,167 個基點，創下這段資料期間的最高紀錄。一個月前，利差為 835 個基點；一年前則為 421 個基點。
標普全球對 CoreWeave 採用 40% 的回收率假設。在這項假設下，目前的定價意味著，該公司未來五年內的違約機率約為 62%。
此外，CoreWeave 與其他 AI 相關企業之間的差距也相當大。如今，CoreWeave 為債務投保所支付的成本，約為微軟 (MSFT-US) 的 21 倍。此外，其成本也是北美投資級信用違約交換指數 (CDX North American Investment Grade Index) 的 18 倍，該指數週一報 63 個基點。
市場有人低聲提起「雷曼」
金融策略師、Windshift Capital 執行長Bill Blain在 10 月 16 日發布的電子報中提出了這項比較。
Blain表示，「CoreWeave 在爭奪成為 AI 債務泡沫第一起重大崩盤事件的競賽中，已經遙遙領先。所有重大的金融泡沫，都需要一個關鍵時刻，讓人們『清醒過來，認清金錢的真相』（或是根本沒有錢）。也就是市場意識到，自己已經不在堪薩斯州的那一刻。」
他接著指出，「2007 年，北岩銀行 (Northern Rock) 遭遇擠兌，短期融資開始枯竭；之後，貝爾斯登 (Bear Stearns) 的 CDO 基金也陷入困境……從那時起，危機開始自行加速發展，雷曼這樣的銀行即將倒閉，也逐漸成為難以避免的局面。」
獨立市場評論員James Foord在 10 月 22 日發布的 Substack 文章中，進一步提出類比。他稱 CoreWeave 是這一輪週期中的雷曼，並表示：「考量到其債券目前反映的風險，這樣的比較是合理的。」
Foord接著將 Nebius Group N.V. 比作這一輪週期中的摩根大通，認為它擁有較強的資產負債表，能夠在市場淘汰潮中存活，並接手其他公司的資產。
摩根大通財富管理部門在 10 月 23 日的一份報告中，也提出了類似的比較，儘管報告並未點名相關公司。
全球投資策略師Justin Biemann描述了一家高度依賴融資的 AI 基礎設施借款企業，其五年期 CDS 在當週攀升至 1,100 個基點。
Biemann指出，這樣的定價意味著，該公司未來五年的違約機率接近或超過 50%，高於一年前不到 30% 的水準。「這並不是預測，但也很難將其視為無關緊要。」不過，他強調，目前的壓力是針對特定企業的。投資人為信用狀況最弱的 AI 借款企業購買債務保障，所需支付的成本約為信用狀況最強企業的 10 倍；整體投資級債券的信用保障成本則仍維持在相對受控的水準。
Biemann表示，市場的擔憂主要集中在這類商業模式：企業必須仰賴債務市場持續開放融資，同時又維持高額支出與有限的現金流。
馬斯克進一步加劇市場壓力
與此同時，馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 週一的發言也讓市場壓力升高。他在社群平台 X 上發文表示，貸款機構幾乎已停止向那些在 AI 資料中心以外缺乏大量營收的公司提供融資。他也預測，200 多家新雲端業者 (neoclouds) 將面臨「小魚等級的死亡潮與產業整併」。
CoreWeave 股價在週一交易時段初期跌至 51.24 美元，創下 2025 年 5 月以來最低水準，之後買盤進場。收盤股價上漲 1.76%，報 55.19 美元。
即便如此，該股仍較過去 52 週的高點 141.79 美元下跌 60%。CoreWeave 目前市值約為 310 億美元，相較之下，其包含租賃負債在內的總債務約為 516 億美元。
不過，摩根大通提醒，不應將 CDS 利差解讀為違約倒數計時。
2005 年，一家美國大型汽車製造商的債務投保成本在其信用評等遭降至垃圾級之前大幅攀升。然而，該公司成功籌集現金、進行重整，最終並未申請破產。
雷曼兄弟則走上了相反的道路。2008 年 9 月中旬，隨著該銀行走向倒閉，其五年期 CDS 利差已升至 1,400 個基點以上。
CoreWeave 目前的利差比這個水準低約 250 個基點。因此，安全緩衝空間已經變得有限，但市場反映的是風險，而不是已經確定的結果。
CoreWeave 最終會走上哪一條路，將取決於貸款機構是否願意繼續為其基礎設施擴建提供資金，直到公司的現金流足以跟上債務規模。
paras_en: Benzinga reported that in the third quarter of 2007, insuring Lehman Brothers’ $10 million debt for one year cost less than $100,000 in premiums. A year later, the same protection cost over $1.4 million, and the bank had filed for bankruptcy. Today, insuring CoreWeave’s (CRWV‑US) debt with comparable coverage costs about $1.15 million per year, reviving a comparison that has been dormant on Wall Street for nearly two decades.
According to data from S&P Global Market Intelligence, CoreWeave’s five‑year credit default swap (CDS) spread reached 1,148 basis points on Monday morning, the 26th.
S&P Global’s twelve‑month data show the spread peaked at 1,167 basis points on October 22, the highest level in the sample period. A month earlier it was 835 bps, and a year ago it was 421 bps.
S&P Global assumes a 40% recovery rate for CoreWeave. Under that assumption, the current pricing implies roughly a 62% probability of default over the next five years.

The gap between CoreWeave and other AI‑related firms is also stark. The cost CoreWeave pays to insure its debt is about 21 times that of Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and roughly 18 times the level of the CDX North American Investment Grade Index, which was quoted at 63 bps on Monday.
The market is quietly invoking “Lehman.”
Financial strategist and Windshift Capital CEO Bill Blain raised the comparison in an October 16 newsletter.

Blain wrote, “CoreWeave is already far ahead in the race to become the first major collapse of the AI‑debt bubble. Every major financial bubble needs a moment when people ‘wake up and see the truth about money’ (or realize there is no money). That moment is when the market realizes it is no longer in Kansas.”

He continued, “In 2007 Northern Rock faced a run and short‑term funding dried up; then Bear Stearns’ CDO funds got into trouble… From there the crisis accelerated on its own, and a bank like Lehman was bound to fail.”

Independent market commentator James Foord expanded the analogy in a Substack post on October 22, calling CoreWeave the Lehman of this cycle and saying, “Given the risk reflected in its bonds, the comparison is reasonable.”
Foord then likened Nebius Group N.V. to the JPMorgan of this cycle, arguing it has a stronger balance sheet that can survive the market purge and absorb other companies’ assets.
JPMorgan’s wealth‑management division made a similar comparison in a report dated October 23, although it did not name any specific firms.
Global investment strategist Justin Biemann described a highly leveraged AI infrastructure borrower whose five‑year CDS jumped to about 1,100 bps that week.

Biemann noted that such pricing implies a default probability of roughly 50% or higher over the next five years, up from under 30% a year earlier. “This is not a forecast, but it’s hard to treat it as irrelevant,” he said, adding that the pressure is currently focused on a specific company. Investors are paying roughly ten times more for credit protection on the weakest AI borrower than on the strongest, while overall investment‑grade bond protection costs remain relatively contained.
Biemann said market worries center on business models that must rely on continuously open debt markets for financing while maintaining high spend and limited cash flow.
Musk Further Fuels Market Pressure

At the same time, Elon Musk’s comments on Monday added to market stress. On X he wrote that lenders have virtually stopped financing companies that lack substantial revenue outside AI data centers. He also warned that more than 200 “neocloud” entrants will face a “small‑fish‑level death spiral and industry consolidation.”
CoreWeave’s stock fell to $51.24 early in Monday’s trading session, its lowest level since May 2025, before buyers stepped in. The share closed up 1.76% at $55.19.
Even so, the stock remains about 60% below its 52‑week high of $141.79. CoreWeave’s market value is roughly $31 billion, while its total debt—including lease liabilities—is about $51.6 billion.
JPMorgan cautioned that CDS spreads should not be read as a countdown to default.

In 2005 a major U.S. automaker saw its debt‑insurance costs surge dramatically before its credit rating slipped into junk territory. The company later raised cash, restructured and avoided bankruptcy.
Lehman Brothers took the opposite path. By mid‑September 2008, as the bank headed toward collapse, its five‑year CDS spread had risen above 1,400 bps.
CoreWeave’s current spread is about 250 bps lower than that level, leaving a limited safety buffer. The market is pricing risk, not a foregone conclusion.
Which path CoreWeave ultimately takes will depend on whether lenders continue to fund its infrastructure expansion until cash flow can keep pace with its debt load.

items.title: 川普任內汽油均價超越拜登時期 柴油價格創歷史新高 期中選舉壓力加劇
items.title_en: Trump's Term Gasoline Prices Surpass Biden Era, Diesel Hits Record High, Midterm Election Pressure Rises
paras: 美國汽油均價在川普總統任內已超越拜登執政時期的整體平均水準，在國會期中選舉前夕令共和黨承壓。
美國汽車協會（AAA）周一（26日）發布的每日數據顯示，川普執政以來美國汽油零售均價為每加侖3.472美元，超過拜登時代的3.471美元，差距不足1美分。這與川普競選時承諾將油價壓至每加侖2美元以下的目標相去甚遠。
截至上周日，美國全國汽油均價已達每加侖4.286美元，創同期歷史最高紀錄。與此同時，柴油價格飆漲尤為引人關注，並已成為影響期中選舉走勢的關鍵變量。
伊朗戰爭爆發以來，中東石油出口受到嚴重衝擊，全球煉油產能進一步承壓，驅動汽油價格大幅攀升。
能源諮詢機構Rystad Energy下游業務資深副總裁Susan Bell表示，目前全球市場每日短缺約40萬桶原本應從中東出口的汽油，中東局勢對供應端的衝擊直接反映在終端油價上。
從歷史紀錄來看，拜登仍保有單日全國最高汽油均價的紀錄——2022年6月，受烏克蘭戰爭影響，油價一度衝至每加侖5.02美元。但就整個執政周期均價而言，川普任內的汽油均價已在本周超越拜登時代。
面對高油價局面，川普政府上周採取了一系列行政舉措。
川普上周四援引《國防生產法》，以提振美國本土燃油生產能力；能源部隨後於上周五宣布，已劃撥1.5億美元專項資金用於煉油廠投資。
然而，供應端結構性缺口難以在短期內彌合。隨著期中選舉臨近，燃油價格走高能否在選前得到有效遏制，仍是市場與選民共同關注的焦點。
paras_en: U.S. gasoline prices averaged during President Trump’s tenure have now exceeded the overall average level of the Biden administration, putting pressure on the Republican Party on the eve of the congressional midterm elections.

Data released Monday (the 26th) by the American Automobile Association (AAA) shows that the average retail price of gasoline in the United States since Trump took office has been $3.472 per gallon, slightly higher than the $3.471 per gallon average during the Biden era—a gap of less than one cent. This is far from Trump’s campaign promise to push oil prices below $2 per gallon.

As of last Sunday, the national average gasoline price in the United States reached $4.286 per gallon, a historic high for the same period. At the same time, diesel prices have surged dramatically and have become a key variable influencing the trajectory of the midterm elections.
Since the outbreak of the war in Iran, oil exports from the Middle East have been severely disrupted, further straining global refining capacity and driving gasoline prices sharply upward.

Susan Bell, senior vice‑president of downstream business at energy consultancy Rystad Energy, said that the global market is currently short about 400,000 barrels of gasoline per day that would normally be exported from the Middle East, and the supply shock from the region is directly reflected in terminal fuel prices.

Historically, Biden still holds the record for the single‑day highest national gasoline price—June 2022, when the war in Ukraine pushed prices up to $5.02 per gallon. However, when looking at the average price over an entire administration, Trump’s average gasoline price has now overtaken Biden’s for the week.
Facing high fuel prices, the Trump administration took a series of administrative actions last week.

On Thursday, Trump invoked the Defense Production Act to boost domestic fuel production; the Energy Department then announced on Friday that it had allocated $150 million in dedicated funds for refinery investments.

Nevertheless, the structural supply gap cannot be closed in the short term. With the midterms approaching, whether the rise in fuel prices can be effectively curbed before the election remains a focal point for both markets and voters.

items.title: 美股選後行情有望續漲？標普500歷史平均漲15.5%、2027年進入總統任期最佳周期
items.title_en: Will Post‑Election US Stocks Keep Rising? S&P 500’s Historical Average Gains 15.5% – 2027 Enters the Best Cycle of a Presidential Term
paras: 標普500指數距離歷史高點可能僅差幾個百分點，但半導體及其他熱門人工智慧（AI）概念股大幅回檔，已讓許多投資人感到不安。好消息是，歷史數據顯示，美股後市未必悲觀。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，長期以來的歷史規律顯示，無論今年11月美國期中選舉由哪個政黨勝出，股市都可能持續走高。
金融顧問內容平台 Exhibit A 創辦人 Matt Cerminaro 的分析指出，自1950年以來，標普500指數從期中選舉投票日到隔年6月30日，平均上漲15.5%。
然而，考慮到市場仍面臨多項可能持續帶來考驗的風險，未來走勢或許不如預期樂觀。儘管本週債市上漲，帶動10年期公債殖利率回落至5%以下，但美國公債殖利率仍接近數十年來的高點。
此外，伊朗戰爭仍在持續，原油價格也回升至投資人自5月以來未曾見過的水準。
此外，Meta(META-US) 最新財報似乎未能消除市場對AI投資報酬的疑慮。隨著Anthropic預計近期上市，部分投資人也擔心，若再出現一宗大型IPO，龐大的新股供給可能超出市場承接能力，進一步壓抑股票需求。
不過，市場也存在正面因素。
CFRA Research首席投資策略師 Sam Stovall 表示：「過去，高油價曾成為熊市的催化因素，利率上升也曾造成同樣的結果。市場面臨的逆風確實很多，但我認為，企業獲利已抵銷了這些逆風帶來的部分疑慮。」
值得注意的是，美國大型企業近期的獲利成長速度相當驚人，華爾街也預期，企業在2027年仍將持續交出亮眼成績。雖然過去的報酬率無法保證未來表現，但從歷史紀錄來看，市場前景仍相當穩健。
Cerminaro表示，期中選舉期間最好的投資策略，就是關掉電視，並在投票日設定買進委託單。
Stovall指出，明年將進入美國總統四年任期周期的第三年，而從歷史來看，這通常是股市表現最強的時期。
在構成總統四年任期周期的16個季度中，期中選舉年的第四季平均表現排名第二；緊接而來的第三年第一季，則是平均表現最佳的季度。
Stovall認為，這種現象並非單純的統計巧合，而與執政黨維持政治優勢的動機有關。他表示，執政黨希望在下一次總統大選後繼續掌權，因此往往會提前採取較為溫和的刺激措施，相關政策效果可能在總統或執政黨尋求連任時逐步顯現。
美國總統川普已經提前展開相關措施。在共和黨國會議員的支持下，川普於2025年推動了具有里程碑意義的減稅措施。
在期中選舉造勢期間，川普也表示，如果共和黨成功保住美國參議院與眾議院的控制權，他將向每位美國成年民眾發放5,000美元的「紅利」。
Stovall的統計也顯示，即使不在選舉年，股市通常也會在第四季交出強勁表現。根據Stovall的統計，第四季是四個曆年季度中平均報酬率最高的季度。
近期股市的主要跌勢集中在科技股。由於科技股在標普500指數中的權重略低於40%，若要讓標普500指數達到與歷史表現相當的報酬率，科技股很可能也必須參與漲勢。
盈透證券首席策略師 Steve Sosnick 表示：「我還沒有完成精確的數學計算，但如果沒有大型科技公司的參與，標普500指數要出現可觀漲幅，可能性極低。」
paras_en: The S&P 500 is only a few percentage points away from its historic peak, but a sharp pullback in semiconductor and other hot AI‑related stocks has left many investors uneasy. The good news is that historical data suggests the US equity market’s outlook may not be bleak.
According to MarketWatch, long‑standing historical patterns show that regardless of which party wins the November midterm elections this year, the stock market could continue to climb.

Analysis by Matt Cerminaro, founder of the financial‑advice platform Exhibit A, notes that since 1950 the S&P 500 has risen an average of 15.5% from the midterm election day to June 30 of the following year.

However, given that the market still faces several risks that could linger, the future trajectory may be less optimistic than hoped. Although the bond market rose this week, pulling the 10‑year Treasury yield back below 5%, US Treasury yields remain near multi‑decade highs.
In addition, the war involving Iran continues, and oil prices have rebounded to levels investors haven’t seen since May.

Meta (META‑US)’s latest earnings also appear to have failed to allay market concerns about AI investment returns. With Anthropic expected to go public soon, some investors worry that another large IPO could flood the market with new shares, overwhelming demand and further suppressing stock buying.
Nevertheless, there are positive factors in the market.

CFRA Research chief investment strategist Sam Stovall said, “In the past, high oil prices have acted as a bear‑market catalyst, and rising rates have produced the same effect. The market does face many headwinds, but I think corporate earnings have offset some of the concerns these headwinds generate.”

It is noteworthy that large US companies have recently posted astonishing profit‑growth rates, and Wall Street expects firms to continue delivering strong results through 2027. While past returns can’t guarantee future performance, historical records suggest the market outlook remains fairly robust.
Cerminaro advises that the best midterm‑election strategy is to turn off the TV and set a buy order for election day.
Stovall points out that next year will be the third year of a US presidential four‑year cycle, which historically is the strongest period for stock performance.

Within the 16 quarters that make up a presidential four‑year cycle, the fourth quarter of a midterm‑election year ranks second on average, while the first quarter of the third year is the top‑performing quarter overall.

Stovall believes this pattern isn’t just a statistical coincidence but is linked to the incumbent party’s motivation to maintain political advantage. He says the ruling party, hoping to stay in power after the next presidential election, often implements relatively moderate stimulus measures early, with policy effects materialising as the president or party seeks re‑election.
US President Trump has already begun rolling out such measures. Backed by Republican members of Congress, Trump pushed a landmark tax‑cut package in 2025.
During the midterm‑election campaign, Trump also said that if Republicans retain control of the Senate and the House, he will give every adult American a $5,000 “bonus.”

Stovall’s statistics also show that even in non‑election years, the stock market typically delivers strong fourth‑quarter performance. According to his data, the fourth quarter has the highest average return of the four calendar quarters.

The recent market decline has been concentrated in technology stocks. Because tech stocks make up just under 40% of the S&P 500, achieving a historically comparable return for the index likely requires tech participation in the rally.

Interactive Brokers chief strategist Steve Sosnick said, “I haven’t completed the precise math yet, but without participation from large tech companies, the odds of the S&P 500 posting a sizable gain are extremely low.”

items.title: 「債券投資人已代勞！」 穆迪首席經濟學家連兩月示警：Fed升息將是一個「錯誤」
items.title_en: Bond Investors Have Already Done the Work! Moody's Chief Economist Warns for Two Consecutive Months That a Fed Rate Hike Would Be a "Mistake"
paras: 面對Fed今年剩下兩次會議及市場對再次升息的預期，穆迪首席經濟學家Mark Zandi週一(26日)在X平台上發文明確反對進一步緊縮貨幣政策，直言「此舉將是錯誤的」。
文中指出，債市已在替Fed完成緊縮任務，當前10年期美債殖利率在5%附近劇烈波動，固定抵押貸款利率穩守7%以上高位，公司債利差亦持續擴大，借貸成本的大幅上升正實質性抑制經濟活動。
Zandi說，「如果利率不能盡快回落，將造成實質性損害」，並強調債券投資人實際上已在執行Fed本該做的工作。
針對本周即將召開的FOMC會議，他特別示警地緣政治風險對通膨的擾動。「受到與伊朗緊張局勢影響，全球油價正急劇回升並逼近戰時高點，這無疑將加劇通膨壓力，但升息並不能解決石油供應問題。相反地，油價上漲會進一步削弱居民實質工資，打擊消費支出，最終拖累經濟」。
Zandi還說，在Fed9月做出升息決定時，他便已警告這是一個「嚴重的錯誤」。如今，在宏觀與地緣不確定性高企之際，Fed正試圖在「戰爭引發的通膨」與「對脆弱經濟日益成長的威脅」之間尋求平衡，此時若選擇升息恐將令經濟陷入停滯的風險。
paras_en: Facing the Fed’s two remaining meetings this year and market expectations of another rate hike, Moody’s chief economist Mark Zandi posted on X on Monday (the 26th) to explicitly oppose further monetary tightening, stating “this would be a mistake.”

He noted that the bond market is already doing the Fed’s tightening job: the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield is swinging wildly around the 5% level, fixed‑rate mortgage rates are holding above 7%, corporate bond spreads continue to widen, and the sharp rise in borrowing costs is materially dampening economic activity.
Zandi said, “If rates do not come down quickly, it will cause real damage,” and stressed that bond investors are actually carrying out the work the Fed should be doing.

Regarding the upcoming FOMC meeting this week, he warned specifically about geopolitical risks disrupting inflation. “Because of tensions with Iran, global oil prices are soaring sharply toward wartime highs, which will undoubtedly intensify inflation pressure, but raising rates cannot solve the oil‑supply problem. On the contrary, higher oil prices will further erode real wages, hit consumer spending, and ultimately drag down the economy.”

Zandi also said that when the Fed makes its September rate‑hike decision, he will have warned that it is a “serious mistake.” Now, amid high macro and geopolitical uncertainty, the Fed is trying to balance “war‑driven inflation” against “the growing threat to a fragile economy,” and choosing to hike rates at this point could risk pushing the economy into stagnation.

items.title: 美股重點新聞摘要2026年10月27日
items.title_en: US Stock Key News Summary October 27, 2026
paras:
特斯拉大漲5%甩開其他「七巨頭」躍居10月漲幅之冠

2026 年大部分時間裡，特斯拉(Tesla)(TSLA-US)一直是「科技七巨頭」（Magnificent Seven）中表現最不起眼成員。但到了 10 月，它卻成了唯一一路加速、把其他成員遠遠甩在後頭的股票。特斯拉股價週一(26日)大漲逾 5%，創下 9 月初以來最大單日漲幅，收盤價也來到近三個月新高。全文詳讀

Meta擬發行350億美元股票 輝達、超微、博通有意掏錢

Meta Platforms (META-US)計劃在未來幾個月透過不同形式的股票發行，籌集近 1,000 億美元。該公司週一(26日)表示，這項計畫將分階段進行。該公司首先計劃發行總額 350 億美元的普通股與特別股，以支應公司在人工智慧領域的投資。Meta 在新聞稿中表示，輝達 (NVDA-US)、超微(AMD-US) 與博通 (AVGO-US) 已表達參與意願，三家公司合計有意透過這次發行認購 50 億美元的股票。全文詳讀

博通與多家銀行合作進行630億美元AI融資 購置AI設備租予Anthropic

博通 (AVGO-US) 攜手美國銀行、黑石、花旗及摩根士丹利，安排規模達630億美元的融資計畫，透過新設立的特殊目的公司 (SPV)，購買博通的人工智慧 (AI) 運算設備，再出租給 Claude 開發商 Anthropic，相關設備預計自2027年開始交付。全文詳讀

總額上看1205億美元 SpaceX可望從Anthropic算力支出中大賺一筆

隨著 Anthropic 未來幾年持續成長，SpaceX (SPCX-US)可望成為其中一大受益者。Anthropic 於週一(26日)提交的首次公開募股（IPO）公開說明書中，揭露了未來幾年可能支付給 SpaceX 的金額。Anthropic 已與 SpaceXAI 簽訂多項協議，將使用搭載輝達 (NVDA-US) GPU 的運算資源，以滿足其運算需求。全文詳讀

蘋果iPhone Duo上市首週傳螢幕破裂 公司證實少數裝置受影響、提供換機

多家媒體報導，蘋果 (AAPL-US) 首款摺疊手機 iPhone Duo 上市首個週末，部分用戶便通報內螢幕破裂，或出現從鉸鏈處延伸的水平亮線。蘋果週一 (26 日) 證實，已知悉少數裝置的內螢幕出現問題，呼籲受影響用戶聯絡 AppleCare 安排換機，但尚未公布故障原因，也未說明是否需要調整設計或製程。全文詳讀
paras_en: Tesla surged more than 5% on Monday, outpacing the other “Magnificent Seven” stocks to claim the top spot for October gains. Throughout most of 2026, Tesla (TSLA-US) had been the least notable member of the tech giants, but in October it became the only stock accelerating ahead, leaving its peers far behind. The share jumped over 5% on Monday the 26th, marking its biggest single‑day rise since early September and closing near a three‑month high.

Meta plans to raise nearly $100 billion through various stock offerings over the coming months. The company said on Monday the 26th that the program will be rolled out in phases, starting with a $35 billion issuance of common and preferred shares to fund its artificial‑intelligence investments. In its press release, Meta noted that Nvidia (NVDA-US), AMD (AMD-US) and Broadcom (AVGO-US) have expressed interest, collectively intending to subscribe for $5 billion of the new shares.

Broadcom (AVGO-US) teamed up with Bank of America, Blackstone, Citi and Morgan Stanley to arrange a $63 billion AI financing program. Through a newly created special‑purpose vehicle, the funds will be used to purchase Broadcom’s AI compute equipment, which will then be leased to Claude developer Anthropic, with deliveries slated to begin in 2027.

Looking at a total of $120.5 billion, SpaceX (SPCX-US) could stand to earn a substantial sum from Anthropic’s compute spending. As Anthropic’s IPO prospectus filed on Monday the 26th shows, the company may pay significant amounts to SpaceX over the next few years. Anthropic has signed multiple agreements with SpaceX AI to use compute resources powered by Nvidia (NVDA-US) GPUs to meet its processing needs.

Apple’s first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, saw reports of screen breakage during its debut weekend. Apple (AAPL-US) confirmed on Monday the 26th that a small number of devices have internal screen issues, advising affected users to contact AppleCare for replacements. The company has not disclosed the cause of the defect nor indicated whether design or manufacturing changes are required.

items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Rises, Euro Weakens Ahead of Central Bank Meetings, Brazilian Real Plummets
paras: 美元周一(26日)上漲， 在各國央行即將召開一連串重要會議之際，歐元兌美元匯率下跌，同時原油價格持續處於高檔。另一方面，巴西總統魯拉（Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva）意外勝選後，巴西雷亞爾大幅貶值。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.31%，報102。
上週由於法國政府公債遭到拋售，法國的債務風險溢酬升至自 2011 年歐洲主權債務危機以來最高，再度引發市場對歐元區可能重陷金融壓力的擔憂，歐元因此承壓。
不過，穆迪（Moody’s）上週並未調降法國的信用評等，緩解了市場部分疑慮。週一，法國政府公債（OAT）價格因此上漲，讓這個正努力改善財政困境的政府稍稍鬆了一口氣。
歐元兌美元下跌 0.21%，至每歐元 1.1179 美元。但歐元兌日元上漲 0.31%，至每歐元 176.04 日元。
法國興業銀行（Société Générale）首席外匯策略師Kit Juckes表示，「歐元面臨的基本問題並沒有改變，而且各國公債利差已經收窄。歐元目前仍容易受到衝擊，因為經濟成長前景不佳，能源價格也依然居高不下。」
布蘭特原油期貨價格雖然小幅回落，但仍維持在近六個月高點附近。油價高漲會對歐元區等仰賴能源進口的經濟體造成壓力。布蘭特原油下跌 0.78%，收於每桶 115.81 美元。
儘管美國面臨通膨上升等不利因素，但穩健的經濟數據仍為美元提供支撐。上週在科技股領跌的市場賣壓中，美元也曾面臨拋售壓力。
本週稍晚，五家主要央行將公布貨幣政策決策。市場預期，美國聯準會（Fed）、歐洲央行（ECB）及日本銀行（BoJ）都將維持利率不變，儘管通膨壓力依然存在。
紐西蘭與加拿大的央行則預計將在本週升息。
日元兌美元下跌 0.43%，至每美元 157.46 日元。
Juckes表示，「美元的表現沒有預期中那麼強勢，也面臨一些不利因素，但美國經濟數據一直相當穩健。」
巴西雷亞爾大幅下挫
巴西總統魯拉於週日勝選，取得歷史性的第四個任期。面對前總統波索納洛（Jair Bolsonaro）長子、參議員Flávio Bolsonaro，魯拉贏得選舉，巴西雷亞爾兌美元匯率隨即大幅下跌。
Bolsonaro在第一輪投票中領先，但在第二輪決選中以超過 400 萬票的差距落敗，震撼了原本押注他會勝選的巴西金融市場。
Bolsonaro拒絕承認敗選，並承諾將要求撤銷選舉結果。
高盛分析師團隊由Teresa Alves領銜，他們在提供投資人的研究報告中表示，「選舉結果若遭到更長時間的爭議，將對市場情緒產生負面影響。更根本的問題是，我們認為巴西雷亞爾及其他當地資產應反映更高的財政風險溢酬，尤其是近幾週政府已大幅放寬財政政策。」
分析師進一步指出，「在先前針對較差財政結果所進行的美元兌雷亞爾匯率評估中，我們認為 5.40 的匯率水準，相當於 2024 年 9 月市場所反映的財政風險溢酬；當時政府尚未在同年 11 月宣布額外的財政措施。至於 5.80 的水準，則代表更高程度的財政風險溢酬，類似於 2024 年 12 月的情況。」
巴西雷亞爾兌美元大幅下跌 8.5%，來到每美元兌 5.4 雷亞爾。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Monday (the 26th) as a series of important central‑bank meetings loom, the euro fell against the dollar, and oil prices remained high. Meanwhile, the Brazilian real sharply depreciated after President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s unexpected election victory.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, rose 0.31% to 102.

Last week, French sovereign bonds were sold off, pushing France’s debt risk premium to its highest level since the 2011 European sovereign debt crisis, reviving market worries that the euro area could once again face financial pressure, and the euro came under strain.

However, Moody’s did not downgrade France’s credit rating last week, easing some market concerns. On Monday, French OAT prices rose, giving the government, which is working to improve its fiscal situation, a slight sigh of relief.
The euro fell 0.21% to $1.1179, while the euro gained 0.31% against the yen, reaching ¥176.04 per euro.

Société Générale chief FX strategist Kit Juckes said, “The euro’s fundamental problems have not changed, and sovereign‑bond spreads have narrowed. The euro remains vulnerable because growth prospects are weak and energy prices stay high.”
Brent crude futures slipped slightly but stayed near six‑month highs. High oil prices pressure economies that rely on energy imports, such as the euro area. Brent fell 0.78% to $115.81 a barrel.

Despite adverse factors like rising inflation in the United States, solid economic data continue to support the dollar. Last week, amid market selling led by tech stocks, the dollar also faced selling pressure.

Later this week, five major central banks will announce policy decisions. Markets expect the Federal Reserve, the European Central Bank and the Bank of Japan to keep rates unchanged, even though inflation pressures persist.
The Reserve Banks of New Zealand and Canada are expected to raise rates this week.
The yen slipped 0.43% to ¥157.46 per dollar.
Juckes added, “The dollar’s performance is not as strong as expected and faces some headwinds, but U.S. economic data have remained quite robust.”
Brazilian real plunges
President Lula won a historic fourth term on Sunday. After defeating former President Jair Bolsonaro’s son, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, the real immediately fell sharply against the dollar.
Bolsonaro led in the first round but lost the runoff by more than four million votes, shocking Brazilian financial markets that had bet on his victory.
Bolsonaro has refused to concede defeat and says he will seek to overturn the election results.

Goldman Sachs analysts led by Teresa Alves wrote in a research note that “If the election outcome remains contested for a longer period, market sentiment will suffer. More fundamentally, we believe the real and other local assets should reflect a higher fiscal‑risk premium, especially as the government has recently relaxed fiscal policy dramatically.”

The analysts further noted, “In our earlier USD/BRL valuation based on poorer fiscal outcomes, we considered a rate of 5.40 as reflecting the fiscal‑risk premium priced by the market in September 2024, before the government announced additional fiscal measures in November. A level of 5.80 would imply an even higher fiscal‑risk premium, similar to the situation in December 2024.”
The Brazilian real fell 8.5% against the dollar, reaching 5.4 reais per dollar.

items.title: 十月累漲4.6%！瑞士股市成為市場AI恐慌下的避風港
items.title_en: October Up 4.6%: Swiss Market Becomes a Safe Haven Amid AI Panic
paras: 瑞士股指本月迄今累計上漲4.6%，而歐元區大盤指數歐洲Stoxx 50同期跌幅則達3.2%，兩者近8個百分點的超額收益創2020年3月以來最高。這一反差背後是歐洲投資人在融資成本走高、AI交易遇冷及法西政局動盪之際，主動降低風險敞口，轉向防禦資產。
上漲幾乎全由三大權重股拉動：羅氏漲12%、諾華漲6.7%、雀巢漲10%，這三檔老牌防禦龍頭貢獻指數全部漲幅，合計佔指數近半權重。
EFG資產管理指出，資金正從擁擠的AI交易撤出，回流獲利紮實、對利率敏感度低的醫藥與食品部門。美銀調查也顯示，淨16%的基金經理人最看好瑞士股市。
支撐行情的還有獲利預期改善。根據《彭博資訊》數據顯示，成分企業2027年獲利成長預期上升至10%，幾乎今年兩倍。
瑞士知名私人銀行薩夫拉薩辛銀行策略師Wolf von Rotberg上調評級至「跑贏大盤」，稱利率、美元及宏觀週期見頂三大因素均利好瑞士市場。
但估值隱憂浮現。經過一輪急漲，瑞士股指相對Stoxx 50的比價重回近兩年高位，估值偏貴限制上行空間。
此外，瑞士法郎本月因避險需求反彈，恐擾動出口導向大盤股獲利。市場正權衡防禦屬性與高估值壓力，修復行情能否延續仍待觀察。
paras_en: Swiss equities have risen 4.6% so far this month, while the Euro‑zone’s broad Stoxx 50 index has fallen 3.2% over the same period, delivering an excess return of nearly eight percentage points – the widest gap since March 2020. The divergence reflects European investors trimming risk exposure as financing costs rise, AI‑driven trading cools, and political turmoil spikes, prompting a shift toward defensive assets.

The gains are almost entirely driven by three heavyweight stocks: Roche up 12%, Novartis up 6.7% and Nestlé up 10%. These three long‑standing defensive leaders account for almost half of the index’s weight and contributed the full upside of the index.

EFG Asset Management notes that capital is flowing out of crowded AI trades and back into solid‑earning, low‑rate‑sensitivity sectors such as pharmaceuticals and food. A Bank of America survey also shows that a net 16% of fund managers are most bullish on Swiss equities.

The rally is also supported by improving earnings expectations. Bloomberg data indicate that the component companies’ profit‑growth outlook for 2027 has risen to 10%, roughly double the forecast made earlier this year.

Wolf von Rotberg, a strategist at Swiss private bank Safra Sarasin, upgraded his rating to “outperform,” saying that peaking interest rates, a strong dollar and a top‑of‑the‑cycle macro environment are all favorable for the Swiss market.

However, valuation concerns are emerging. After a sharp rally, the Swiss index’s price‑to‑Stoxx 50 multiple has returned to near‑two‑year highs, making the market look expensive and capping further upside potential.

In addition, the Swiss franc has rebounded this month on safe‑haven demand, which could hurt profit margins of export‑oriented large‑cap stocks. The market is weighing defensive appeal against overvaluation pressure, and it remains to be seen whether the rally can be sustained.

items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Rises, Yen Gains After AI Stock Plunge, French Debt Concerns Drag Euro
paras: 美元周五(23日)小幅上漲，美元指數本週變動不大。歐元則受法國政府公債遭拋售影響走低，法國債務風險溢酬升至2011年歐元區主權債務危機以來最高水準，歐元兌美元與日元均以週線收黑作收。日元受惠於週四AI概念股遭拋售引發的避險資金流入，兌美元本週上漲。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.25%，報101.82，本週上漲約0.03%。
市場對法國國內動盪加劇及預算問題惡化的憂慮，持續打擊歐元。法國內政部長Laurent Nuñez表示，法國將於週六部署7萬名警察，並由特種警力支援，以因應抗議活動。此外，穆迪（Moody’s）也可能於週五調降法國的信用評等。
Bannockburn Global Forex 首席市場策略師 Marc Chandler 表示，「今天歐洲債券市場的壓力已有所緩解，但穆迪稍晚對法國債務評等的檢視仍是一項挑戰。儘管馬克宏政府已威脅動用軍事力量平息社會動盪，但週末可能仍會有更多活動發生。」
歐元兌美元下跌0.21%，至1.1191美元，本週下跌約0.43%。
歐元兌日元跌幅更大，一度觸及175.08日圓，創2025年10月以來最低。歐元兌日元下跌0.11%，本週跌約1.1%。
日元兌美元下跌0.1%，至156.9日元，但本週上漲約0.7%，創下9月中旬以來最佳單週表現。
三菱日聯金融集團（MUFG）資深外匯分析師 Lee Hardman 表示，「隨著本週尾聲的避險交易氣氛升溫，日元持續維持在較強勢水準。」
央行政策會議成市場焦點
交易員正關注下週美國聯準會（Fed）、歐洲央行（ECB）及日本銀行（BoJ）的政策會議。市場預期三家央行都將維持利率不變，但投資人將尋找未來貨幣政策走向的線索。
根據倫敦證券交易所集團（LSEG）數據，週四股市遭拋售後，聯邦基金利率期貨交易員下調了對聯準會12月升息的押注，但市場仍認為升息機率達81%。
交易員目前預估，歐洲央行12月升息的機率為66%。投資人將仔細檢視任何有關利率前景的訊號。歐洲央行總裁拉加德（Christine Lagarde）9月底曾表示，面對通膨，採取適度的政策反應是合適的。
採購經理人指數（PMI）數據顯示，歐元區民間部門10月成長速度放緩，降至四個月來最疲弱水準，主要受到法國經濟活動再度萎縮拖累。
花旗經濟學家 Giada Giani 表示，「我們認為，這次數據下滑讓PMI回到與其他經濟成長指標一致的水準，而非意味著未來下行風險正在增加。法國仍是拖累因素，但歐元區其他地區依然展現韌性。」
日本方面，週五公布的數據顯示，9月核心消費者物價年增率九個月來首度超過日本央行2%的通膨目標。分析師表示，這項數據顯示價格壓力正擴大至更多領域，也強化日銀近期升息的理由。

paras_en: The dollar edged higher on Friday (the 23rd), with the DXY showing little change this week. The euro fell as French government bonds were sold off, pushing France's sovereign debt risk premium to its highest level since the Euro‑area crisis of 2011. Both the euro‑dollar and euro‑yen pairs closed the week in the red. The yen benefited from a flight‑to‑safety flow triggered by Thursday’s sell‑off in AI‑related stocks, rising against the dollar over the week.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.25% to 101.82, up about 0.03% for the week.

Market worries about escalating domestic turmoil in France and worsening budget issues continued to weigh on the euro. French Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said France will deploy 70,000 police officers, supported by special forces, on Saturday to address protests. Moody’s also may downgrade France’s credit rating on Friday.

Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Global Forex, said, “The pressure on European bond markets has eased today, but Moody’s later review of France’s debt rating remains a challenge. Although the Macron government has threatened to use force to quell social unrest, more activity could still occur over the weekend.”
The euro fell 0.21% against the dollar to $1.1191, down about 0.43% for the week.
The euro‑yen pair slipped further, briefly hitting ¥175.08, the lowest since October 2025, down 0.11% and about 1.1% for the week.
The yen slipped 0.1% to ¥156.9 per dollar, but is up roughly 0.7% for the week, marking its best weekly performance since mid‑September.
Lee Hardman, senior FX analyst at MUFG, said, “With the hedge‑fund atmosphere heating up toward the end of the week, the yen remains firmly on the stronger side.”
Central‑bank policy meetings become market focus

Traders are watching next week’s policy meetings of the U.S. Federal Reserve, the European Central Bank and the Bank of Japan. Markets expect all three central banks to keep rates unchanged, but investors will look for clues on future monetary‑policy direction.

According to data from the London Stock Exchange Group, after Thursday’s equity sell‑off, Fed‑funds futures traders reduced bets on a December rate hike, yet the market still sees an 81% probability of a hike.

Traders currently estimate a 66% chance that the ECB will raise rates in December. Investors will scrutinise any signals about the rate outlook. ECB President Christine Lagarde said at the end of September that a measured policy response to inflation is appropriate.

Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) data showed that euro‑area private‑sector growth slowed in October to its weakest level in four months, mainly dragged down by a renewed contraction in French economic activity.

Citigroup economist Giada Giani said, “We think this data dip brings the PMI back in line with other growth indicators rather than signalling rising downside risk. France remains a drag, but the rest of the euro area continues to show resilience.”

In Japan, Friday’s data showed that September core CPI year‑over‑year finally exceeded the Bank of Japan’s 2% inflation target for the first time in nine months. Analysts said the figure indicates price pressure spreading to more sectors and bolsters the case for a near‑term rate hike by the BOJ.
Traders now assign a 61% probability to a BOJ rate increase in December.

items.title: 美銀Hartnett示警避險潮延續至11月中 股市、美元、殖利率齊跌
items.title_en: Bank of America’s Hartnett Warns Hedge Wave Will Persist Into Mid‑November, Stocks, Dollar and Yields All Falling
paras: 美銀(BAC-US) 策略師Michael Hartnett預期，市場避險情緒可能延續至11月中旬，債券殖利率、股市與美元恐同步下跌。圍繞人工智慧（AI）交易及美國期中選舉的不安情緒，正壓抑股市表現，促使投資人轉向防禦性資產。
Hartnett週五在致客戶的報告中表示：「我們在戰術上維持避險立場至11月中旬。」他預期，市場將出現殖利率下跌、股市下跌及美元下跌的交易格局。
他指出，市場仍須充分反映民主黨同時取得眾議院與參議院控制權的可能性。在他看來，這樣的選舉結果將終結當前低稅、低監管的政策環境，不利企業獲利成長。
至於風險偏好何時可能回升，Hartnett認為，若歐洲央行或法國政府出手扭轉法國公債賣壓，可能成為訊號之一。
近期令市場不安的AI超大規模雲端服務商債券利差，也是一項觀察重點。他表示，若這些企業削減資本支出，或宣布「極大規模」的股權融資，使債券利差見頂，也可能緩解市場壓力。
儘管疑慮升溫，資金仍持續流入AI相關領域。美銀引述EPFR Global數據指出，科技股獲得7月以來最大單週資金流入。美銀本月公布的調查也顯示，全球投資人對科技股的曝險程度，升至2020年8月以來最高。
不過，最近幾天投資人也開始轉向防禦性資產，以因應油價上漲、融資成本攀升，以及AI交易可能逐漸泡沫化等風險。億萬富豪肯．格里芬（Ken Griffin）本週便警告，投資人「幾乎可以肯定」正身處AI泡沫之中。
資金轉向的跡象也反映在類股表現上。作為衡量市場廣度的指標，標普500等權重指數週四相對於市值加權的標普500指數，創下2024年以來最佳單日表現；防禦性較強的民生必需消費品類股，則可望締造1998年以來最佳單月表現。
paras_en: Bank of America (BAC-US) strategist Michael Hartnett expects the market’s hedging sentiment to continue into mid‑November, with bond yields, equities and the dollar likely to fall together. Anxiety surrounding AI‑driven trading and the U.S. midterm elections is suppressing stock performance and pushing investors toward defensive assets.

Hartnett wrote in a client note on Friday: “We will maintain a tactical hedging stance through mid‑November.” He anticipates a trading environment of falling yields, declining equities and a weaker dollar.

He noted that the market still needs to fully price in the possibility that Democrats could control both the House and the Senate. In his view, such an outcome would end the current low‑tax, low‑regulation policy regime, which is unfavorable for corporate profit growth.
As for when risk appetite might rebound, Hartnett sees a potential signal if the European Central Bank or the French government steps in to curb the selling pressure on French sovereign bonds.

Another focus is the widening credit spreads of ultra‑large AI cloud service providers, which have recently unsettled markets. He said that if these firms cut capital expenditures or announce “massive” equity financings that cap spreads, market pressure could ease.

Despite rising concerns, money continues to flow into AI‑related areas. Bank of America cites EPFR Global data showing the biggest weekly inflow into tech stocks since July, and its own survey this month indicating global investors’ exposure to tech stocks has risen to its highest level since August 2020.

However, in recent days investors have begun shifting toward defensive assets to hedge against rising oil prices, higher financing costs and the potential bubble in AI trading. Billionaire Ken Griffin warned this week that investors are “almost certainly” in an AI bubble.

The shift is also reflected in sector performance. As a breadth gauge, the equal‑weight S&P 500 posted its best single‑day performance this year on Thursday relative to the market‑cap‑weighted S&P 500, while defensive consumer‑staples stocks are on track for their strongest monthly gain since 1998.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元持平 日元走強 油價、AI與法國局勢引發市場不安
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Flat, Yen Strengthens; Oil, AI and French Situation Stir Market Unease
paras: 美元周四(22日)大致持平，日元則有望創下近一個月來最大單日漲幅。由於股市表現脆弱、中東戰事延宕推升原油價格，以及市場對人工智慧（AI）未來投資報酬的疑慮升高，投資人紛紛尋求避險。
歐元兌美元下跌0.09%，至1.1222美元。法國社會動盪的疑慮，以及該國財政前景惡化的問題，影響力超過了AI交易的擔憂，後者則拖累美國股市走低。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.08%，報101.60。
Daiwa Capital Markets經濟研究主管Chris Scicluna表示，「AI讓人感到不安，油價也是如此……法國局勢同樣令人擔憂。」
在葉門武裝組織青年運動（Houthi）攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯後，市場擔心這個重要能源出口地區的供應將進一步受到干擾，推動油價上漲約3%，升至五個月高點。
日元兌美元升值0.75%，至156.96日元兌1美元。
日元走強的部分原因，也可能與匯價接近160這個關鍵水準有關。市場認為，一旦日元逼近160，日本當局進一步干預匯市、支撐日元的可能性就會升高。
Convera首席外匯與總體經濟策略師Kevin Ford將此稱為「干預溢價」，並指出，「每當日元接近160關卡，市場對央行出手干預的猜測就會升溫。」
在另一傳統避險貨幣瑞士法郎方面，美元兌瑞郎下跌0.42%，至每美元兌0.821瑞郎。
美元走勢愈來愈受到資本流動，以及與AI交易相關的經濟成長和通膨預期影響。上週由於市場對AI前景的疑慮升高，美元走跌，然而，週四市場對法國局勢的擔憂則占了上風。
富國銀行全球外匯策略主管Erik Nelson表示，「目前存在彼此競爭的市場敘事與脆弱環節，一方面是美國與AI相關的信用風險，另一方面則是法國的主權信用風險。過去幾天，這兩項因素持續拉鋸，有時其中一項比另一項更令人擔憂。」
他接著表示，「只要法國的風險比美國AI相關信用風險更受市場擔憂，歐元表現就會相對疲弱。」
法國總統馬克宏(Emmanuel Macron)週四表示，未來幾天將禁止「不合法」的抗議活動，並將上週末的暴動與掠奪事件歸咎於「煽動叛亂的」極左派團體及破壞公物者。
市場對法國能否妥善管理龐大債務負擔的疑慮，已衝擊法國公債，並引發對歐元區其他高負債國家的擔憂。週四，法國與德國10年期公債殖利率利差擴大至177.7個基點，為2011年以來最大。

paras_en: The dollar was roughly flat on Thursday (the 22nd), while the yen is poised to record its biggest single‑day gain in about a month. Weak equity markets, lingering Middle‑East conflict pushing up oil prices, and growing doubts about the future returns on artificial‑intelligence (AI) investments have led investors to seek safe havens.

The euro fell 0.09% against the dollar to $1.1222. Concerns over social unrest in France and the country’s deteriorating fiscal outlook outweighed worries about AI‑driven trading, which has been dragging U.S. equities lower.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.08% to 101.60.
Chris Scicluna, head of economic research at Daiwa Capital Markets, said, “AI is unsettling, oil prices are too… the situation in France is equally worrisome.”
After a Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia, markets feared further supply disruptions in this key energy‑export region, pushing oil prices up about 3% to a five‑month high.
The yen rose 0.75% against the dollar to ¥156.96 per $1.

One reason for the yen’s strength may be its approach to the critical ¥160 level. Market participants think that once the yen nears ¥160, Japanese authorities are more likely to intervene in the forex market to support the currency.

Kevin Ford, chief FX and macro strategist at Convera, called this an “intervention premium” and noted, “Whenever the yen approaches the 160 barrier, speculation about central‑bank intervention heats up.”
On another traditional safe‑haven currency, the Swiss franc, the dollar fell 0.42% to 0.821 CHF per $1.

The dollar’s trajectory is increasingly shaped by capital flows and expectations for economic growth and inflation linked to AI trading. Last week, heightened doubts about AI’s outlook pulled the dollar down, but on Thursday market concerns over France took precedence.

Erik Nelson, global FX strategy head at Wells Fargo, said, “There are competing market narratives and fragile points right now: on one side, U.S. AI‑related credit risk; on the other, France’s sovereign credit risk. In recent days these two factors have been tug‑of‑war, with one sometimes outweighing the other.”
He added, “As long as France’s risk is more concerning to the market than U.S. AI‑related credit risk, the euro will remain relatively weak.”
French President Emmanuel Macron said on Thursday that “illegal” protests would be banned in the coming days, blaming last weekend’s riots and looting on “subversive” far‑left groups and vandals.

Market doubts about France’s ability to manage its massive debt load have hit French government bonds and sparked worries about other highly indebted euro‑area countries. On Thursday the spread between French and German 10‑year yields widened to 177.7 basis points, the widest since 2011.
The pound rose 0.05% against the dollar to $1.3401.
